Government scheme of the Ministry of Education (Taiwan) under the New Southbound Policy, delivered through multiple participating universities (e.g. NCKU, Taipei Tech). University-wide excellence scholarship administered by UNIL's Social Affairs and Student Mobility Service (SASME); official contact mastergrants@unil.ch. Selection is made by an unnamed Selection Board with faculties deciding on admission; no named professor appears on official pages.

Invitation-only, merit-based Bachelor scholarship administered by the University of St.Gallen's Advice Center for Study Funding; 'The final selection of scholarship awardees is the responsibility of the relevant committees' (committees unnamed). No professors named on official pages; bachelor's programmes have no supervisors.
